title: Self-secure SOS sequence acceptance (check accept() return, order before cancel)
description: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:306-307 (_cancel_from_body) and pre-existing at render_post:272-274 / render_delete:354-355: the boolean return of self._sequences.accept() is discarded; safety depends on the adjacent last_seen pre-check with no await between them. Any refactor inserting an await between check and accept breaks it. Harden: 'if not self._sequences.accept(...): return UNAUTHORIZED' (accept returns False on non-advancing), and in _cancel_from_body swap accept() to precede... rather: call accept() only after cancel() succeeds, or check its return, so a raise in cancel() cannot leave a consumed sequence with the alert still active (verified unreachable with pinned aiocoap, defensive only).
